links.notes: Image shows the PTT Group corporate logo with distinctive flame/droplet symbol in blue, cyan, and red colors alongside 'ptt Group' wordmark in navy blue italic text.
PTT stands for Petroleum Authority of Thailand; flame/droplet logo iconography is strongly associated with petroleum/energy sector.
PTT is Thailand's national petroleum and energy company, state-owned enterprise.
PTT.png is stored in the Macchanu project repository alongside other sponsor logos, indicating PTT Group is likely a sponsor of the Macchanu project/team.
The flame/water-droplet composite symbol in the logo visually represents energy (flame) and petroleum/liquid fuel (droplet), consistent with oil and gas industry branding.
